After displacing to Formate mud drilling continued to core point at 1075m. Tight hole was noted at 943m when picking up off bottom to stop circulating to change shaker screens. Sticky claystone caused minor mud losses at the shakers. After circulating bottoms up ti

ns to seabed. ROV monitored the wellhead for possible gas. Dxc values remained broadly on the normal trend line chosen for this section. No significant deviation. Hole Condition/Cleaning Hole conditions were generally good and no tight hole or hole instability was observed while drilling the section apart from 40 tonnes overpull at 458m.
